title: Szydagis tests alleged crash debris with neutron activation
summary: Kevin Knuth tells of Szydagis tests alleged crash debris with neutron activation, about 2020s at University at Albany, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: My colleague Matthew Shadalagus has been working on studying debris from alleged crashes.

plain: A physicist and former NASA scientist, Kevin Knuth, says on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels that his colleague Matthew Szydagis, at the University at Albany, has been studying debris said to come from UFO crashes. According to the story, Szydagis tests it with neutron activation, a method that bombards a sample with tiny particles to reveal what elements it contains, which could show whether the material is unusual.
